title: Sell with Chariow
notConnectedHint: Connect your Chariow store to sell your digital products and track sales.
webhookHint: Create a Pulse in Chariow (Automations → Pulses) with this URL and select the successful.sale, failed.sale, abandoned.sale events. Then paste the secret (whsec_…) when connecting.
webhookSecretHint: whsec_… created with the Pulse. Can be added later. Without webhooks, sales are synced via “Sync sales”.
linkHint: The Chariow API cannot create products: pick a product already created and published in your Chariow store.
buySubtitle: A valid email and phone number are required for product delivery.
purchaseCompleted: Purchase confirmed! Your product has been delivered.
